title: unpairing the pump (Equil 5.3)
body: I have AAPS version 3320 which works in a loop with Equil 5.3. The pump broke (probably the bluetooth module) and there is no connection with it, but it is still paired with AAPS. Tomorrow I will have a new Equil Pump, but how to unpair or remove the old pump in this situation? It seems to me that I cannot pair the new pump without removing the old one. I would really appreciate your help.
